messages:
alex: Quick sync 10-min - marketing wants a lightweight pricing experiment: add a tiny inline estimator, test new tier names, and swap CTA copy. Can we ship a minimal version this week? jamie: I can do the micro-embed. Prefer a tiny JS snippet so it won't block SSR. Prototype: `
` ruth: I'll write FAQ microcopy. Proposal: tiers = "Starter / Growth / Enterprise" for the test. CTA variant: 'See my estimate' vs baseline 'Get started'. Also add a short FAQ line: "Estimates are indicative and may change based on negotiated contracts." sam: Analytics names: rw_mini_open, rw_mini_submit, rw_mini_value_usd, rw_contact_cta. Payload: estimated_usd, tier_choice, utm_source. Routing rule from sales: if estimated_usd >= 5000 OR tier_choice == 'Enterprise' -> AE queue. Add field webinar_opt_in boolean. deploy-bot: PR to staging opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing-site/pull/2222 by jamie (:rocket:) alex: Great. Plan: ship to staging, run 14-day A/B, measure signup CTA lift (primary) and Contact Sales drop (secondary). Ruth/sam, please drop final copy + event names by EOD. Ping #eng-oncall if anything spikes. Thanks! :tada:
